notes.title: A couple small but critical fixes
notes.notes:
Quick Version:

1 - Boons are less powerful now.
2 - But you can carry more with upgrades strength.
3 - Siege scene is a tad easier now.

Explained:

There was a very big problem with the economics that effects the Travel chapters. I was focusing so much on the new features that this totally slipped past me.

We know that "boons" are very useful. They help clear the screen and give bonus points for the chapter. It was supposed to "multiply your bonus by the number of items on the screen".

Well, I accidentally had it set to multiply by ALL ITEMS that had past this chapter. So the longer you played, the bigger the bonus. Thus making it way too easy!

Doh!

Fixed that. Better now.

ALSO. If you upgrade your strength you can carry more boons now. I think that's fair. A reward for investment.

And if you invest in Armor you can carry more "wine" (potions).

AND. I made the Siege scene a bit easier. I always wanted to do that. Finally got to it today.

notes.title: Fixed critical bugs.
notes.notes:
Thanks to a player for helping with testing! I just managed to fix some critical bugs. 

The game was crashing due to "tweeners". A very trivial thing. Basically it means "animations wanted to do something while the player was trying to leave the stage" and that caused a conflict which crashed the game.

Seems really dumb right?

That's code for ya'.

Hopefully that's fixed now and we can put it behind us. If not please let me know.

notes.title: Major Update and Bug Fixes - May 1st 2025
notes.notes:
Hey there!

Thanks to a Steam player, we found out the game was live with major issues. Images weren't showing correctly. Sorry about that! It's complicated, but there's a reason I couldn't see that from my development PC. If I had known I would have fixed it much sooner. Thanks again to the amazing player who helped us out. If anyone else wants to contribute checkout the Steam Community page [link below]

So that's fixed now and since I had to upload a new release to fix it, I added all the latest features and graphics along with it. Not much more content, but we really polished the cyberpunk books, Neo Athenia (name changed slightly).

Meanwhile, I've been working HARD on adding new features and we have 2 artists working on new art.  The new features are going to add tons of depth to the story of the game. More than just [Strength, Intelligence]. Now we have 

- CRAFTING - you can make a sandwich!
- OBJECT STATES - you can change the state of objects. broken, fixed, on, off, etc
- STAT GATES - high intelligence = better hacker. high ingenuity = better crafting.

The overall schedule, which I'm very excited about, goes like this:

1 - I'm very close to wrapping up the development tools needed for the new IMMERSIVE SIM features.

2 - Then we do nothing but make content all year long.

Along the way we'll keep adding mini-games and activities, but the main storytelling component of the game will be 100% done.

This will put content speed into overdrive. Knock on wood. Check out the upgrades and get ready for more great stuff coming soon!

Find bugs? Please help by reporting.

Steam Community Page: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2183340/discussions/

-Keystone Library

notes.title: Keystone Library - Merry Christmas 2024!
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wSORzYO.png[/img]

After an enormous amount of work, I hereby present to you the latest version of Keystone Library.

We now have 3 books! Not complete books, but nonetheless - THREE BOOKS! I've kept a small team of people very busy over the past year. I can't believe how long it's been and how much we put into this. What a journey!

But there's MUCH MUCH more to speak of in this new edition.

We've added an actual "library" to Keystone Library. You can walk through the halls, meet some characters, and do a few new things to keep you busy between your adventures in the stories.

It's fun! And it will be even more fun in the future as we continue to add to the library.

We have 5 chapters of a new cyberpunk themed book. "New Athenia" and 5 chapters of the previously released fantasy themed book "Quest of the Lake". And the original Greek Mythology book which is mostly a typing game, but still lots of fun!

What else?!

Optimization. Despite having more content, we have a REDUCED file size, and everything is running faster and smoother than ever. Enhanced graphics. Improved interface design. More intuitive interface. Better graphic and sound controls in settings. The list goes on...

There are still problems, and I am aware of some bugs and some issues. The most obvious problem is the remaining lack of content, but that's why this release is so important. I'm hoping we can start to get the word out there and generate some excitement for Keystone Library. Once we start to build up the hype, that can help inspire more content.

I believe this release has a "full picture" of what the game is meant to be. It's a good foundation which expresses the flexibility and versatility of the chapter-based system of the Keystone books. So now with that out of the way we just need to...

1 - Keep improving upon existing things.

2 - Content, content, content. More books, more stories, more cool stuff to play with.

That's really the only thing holding us back at this point. Mostly illustration content, because that can be time consuming. We've had a few problems with illustrators over the past couple years, probably my fault due to my inexperience. But I'm getting better at it, and thus, ANOTHER upgrade we have - is an improved workflow to get more content coming out much faster than before. We have a much better system now, very streamlined, and with that I do hope to finish a couple more books at lightning speed!

If all goes well we'll have a few more releases coming up throughout 2025, and then a final release out of EA in 2026.

Full steam ahead!

Oh yeah. We have a website now too! 

[url=https://www.keystonelibrary.com]https://www.keystonelibrary.com[/url]


- Brendon
Keystone Library

notes.title: Stable version update.
notes.notes:
I just uploaded the latest stable version of the game. Over the past week a bad version was uploaded and mostly didn't work at all. But I couldn't update due to security problems and had to wait a few days. 

So during those few days I decided to also fix a bunch of small issues and clean up the system a bit. Everything seems to be running very smoothly now. I'm very happy with this release and looking forward to the next one. 

I've had a lot of struggles with system design and bugs over the past year or two, but everything seems to be falling into place now - which means we can focus more THE CONTENT. And I'm very excited about that! 

This will be a lot of fun. :)

notes.title: Keystone Library Major Update v2.0
notes.notes:
March 26, 2024.

This update has been a long time coming. I've added a ton of functionality for new types of chapter scenes, and worked together with our small team to add tons of new art, music, and effects. Currently we have 29 chapters of Greek Mythology content and the first 5 chapters of a fantasy story "Quest of the Lake" is up and ready to play.

I also have 5 chapters of a Cyberpunk style story just waiting to get setup, and I hope to do that over the next few weeks. So things should really start churning and burning rapidly here over the course of the next few months. 

The content system has been totally revamped and we can focus on perpetual content updates from here on out. ~~~ knock on wood!

The ultimate goal, to get out of Early Access, is to have 3 completed books in the library, and a few additional novelty features - such as a very basic library environment to play in, an illustrated library where you can manage your profile or maybe buy a pet with your experience points - something like that.

I'm looking forward to see how much we get done this year. 

NOTE: This major update is likely to have smaller subsequent updates while I continue to tweak some of the latest content. It might be useful to EXIT Steam and make sure you get the full version.

Please contact me with any bugs or problems, ideas or complaints. 

Brendon
bschu.net

notes.title: Keystone Library - Season 1.4 - MAJOR UPDATES
notes.notes:
This months updates are very late. I was supposed to update Mar 14th. The good news is that the updates are SUBSTANTIAL, and that's why it took so long. 

1 - Completely revamped the graphics.
2 - Added a parallax effect to every chapter animation.
3 - Added special effects - smoke, birds flying, sun glare, particles, etc.
4 - Completely updated sound system for better volume.
5 - Add "ambient sound" such as ocean waves, mountain wind, forrest sounds, etc.
6 - Updated save system and menu system.
7 - Updated art for Shop and Companion scenes.
8 - Completely updated the companion to act like a real interactive friend.
9 - Updated all Pastimes to be more engaging.
10 - Added BONUSES for when you complete a chapter Unscathed, Perfect, and Immaculate (the latter means you not only hit every word, but attended every Side Quest).
11 - I started on the final boss, but it still needs time.

So now, every chapter of this first book is 100% complete, or at least 99% complete for now. I only have to complete the very final chapter - the final boss. And that will be completed in the next release (end of this month or early next month). And then this beautiful mythology book will finally be complete and we can move on to the next book. 

Actually, I will probably do a few shorter books before working on the next major volume, just to take it easy on myself and see some more content build as a reward to myself. It'll be very satisfying to see a few more books on the shelves of Keystone Library -- having put so much into this for so many months already. 

That's all for now. Any further news will be reported in the Steam Community or on the publishing website www.dream-gears.com

notes.title: Ambient Graphic Updates en Route
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43176058/620b92d1d10eee1c2f0289b956a3a0b170ecb5e9.png[/img]

I've been polishing the graphics system and working with the sound designer to create the best environments possible with our humble game.

The latest features will be updated in a few days. We're busy testing and tying up loose ends.

The list:

1 - Each illustration is split into layers, which allowed me to add a parallax effect, and it makes a HUGE different.

2 - I added a dynamic ambient effect system. Smoke, particles, birds, bats, all types of stuff!

3 - Scoring system update. If you do a perfect run you get bonuses! Complete the chapter UNSCATHED for x1.5 bonus. Don't miss a word for PERFECT bonus x2. And if you collect everything and also don't skip any Side Quests you'll get the IMMACULATE bonus for a whipping x3 bonus!!! Holy Cow! Times Three!!!

4 - Improvements to saves. The save will remember your chosen resolution... oh yeah... did I mean you can toggle full screen and choose a window resolution? The options are Full screen, 900p, and 720p. Obviously 720p is quite small for a PC game, and it might not be fully supported, but I do hope to maintain support for smaller resolutions too. 

5 - Pastimes are all update for more dynamics and improved challenges.

6 - Various illustration and interface updates which should be quite noticeable.

That's about all for now. 

Uploads in a few days.

notes.title: Major Update - Feb 14th - Happy Valentines Day!
notes.notes:
Season 1.3 has begun!

[b]Short Version:[/b] 9 New Chapters. Tons of quality updates.

Today we have a lot of updates, so many various things that I can't put it into words. I've done graphics updates, content updates, video and audio improvements, and my personal favorite -- Data upgrades which will make future content releases much easier for me! Yay! Woohoo! Woof woof woof! 

This content will nearly complete the entire Season 1 - Greek Mythology. The only thing remaining is the final boss challenge for this book.

The upcoming workflow should go like this:

1 - Finalize all content up to the final boss
2 - Make some graphic and audio updates
3 - Publish everything

And then I will go back to working on the final boss scene, and next time I update I will publish the final boss, and Season 1 will be complete.

In March I will start on Season 2, a much shorter book with a more simple theme.

ALSO. I have secretly started on additional features for Keystone Library. I will be adding some environment upgrades and achievements. So you can customize your experience and upgrade your own personal library as you go along. This should be a fun pastime addition for a casual game like this.

We just had a major content update. There are 20 full chapters to play now, and including a bigger variety of games - not just the typing game and side quests. Now have a third type of stage called "Pastimes", and there will be a variety of pastime activities to help spice up the game.
